name: A Copper Caretaker
jem_summary: Summon a Copper Golem and let it complete an item transport from a Copper Chest.

pages.title: A Copper Caretaker
pages.text: Summon a Copper Golem and let it complete an item transport from a Copper Chest.

pages.title: A Copper Caretaker
pages.text: Demonstrate genuine golem storage help; a barrel and honeycomb expand and preserve the storage area.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Use the native carved-pumpkin-on-copper assembly. Provide a Copper Chest and valid destination inventories; wax preserves chest oxidation. Random copper-button pressing is separate from sorting.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Place a carved pumpkin on a copper block. Summon the backported Copper Golem.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Provide a Copper Golem with Copper Chests and items to transport. Use its native item-transport behavior, subject to configuration.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Place Copper Buttons near a Copper Golem. Let the golem randomly press nearby supported buttons.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Wax a Copper Chest. Control oxidation of copper storage; the author also supports double chests.
